scope.unit: directed dyad-month; actor views aggregate exact contributions

exactness.temperature_note: selected T=1.0; the temperature column is the sigmoid/logit round-trip of the raw track, not an independent calibration fit; the affine identity is unit-tested at T=2
exactness.accumulator_warning: full-stream 1e-6 check flags float32 predict_proba round-trip, not a decomposition failure

source_target.interpretation: Attribution is relative to the training mean; positive values push the dyad above average and do not imply high absolute risk.

rubric.note: fixed before inspecting stability numbers; reporting convention only, not model selection

holdout.note: The confirmatory holdout completed after this audit (2026-10-23T07:45:19Z). All eventual holdout dyads were excluded from fitting and aggregation; no holdout label was used.

null_benchmark.note: Expected overlap of two independent random top-k sets of 196 actors; a descriptive null, not a significance test.

release_annotations.note: Post-freeze release annotations only: accurate holdout timing/status, release banner, null for undefined JSON values, and the final wording sync. The shipped numbers are the holdout-excluded 50-refit rerun; no stability number was changed.
